html:
Georgia Property Renovation Services Quote

Want a clear, written estimate for a renovation in Georgia? Submit the form or email info@buildheritage.org and you’ll get a free, itemized quote within one business day.

How to get your quote

  1. Fill out the quote form and pick the trades you need—painting, flooring, roofing, etc.
  2. We review your details and prepare a written, itemized estimate.
  3. You receive the estimate the next business day, review it, and decide what to do next.

What the estimate covers

  • A line‑by‑line breakdown for any mix of our eight trades: Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles.
  • Cost ranges from our August 2026 guide: full roof replacement $9,000‑$20,000; whole‑home interior repaint $3,000‑$8,000.
  • A note to hold back 10‑15 % of the quoted amount for hidden issues that may surface during work.
  • Confirmation that the work will be done by a contractor licensed and insured in Georgia.

Service areas

We serve metro Atlanta and the wider Georgia region: Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

Who can use this service

Property managers, apartment owners, HOAs, brokers, and investors use our quote service to plan renovations, compare costs, and stay organized.

FAQ

How quickly will I receive the quote? You’ll get a written estimate within one business day after you submit the form or email.

Is there a fee for the quote? No. The quote is free and fully itemized.

How much should I set aside for unexpected issues? The cost guide recommends holding back 10‑15 % of the quoted total for hidden problems that may arise.

Next step

Ready to start? Click the button below to open the quote form and get your free, written estimate today.

Get your free Georgia property renovation services quote
